description: This file defines a centralized theme configuration class for a Flutter application using Material 3 design. It specifies colors, typography, and component styles to ensure a consistent look and feel aligned with a particular style guide.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing a static getter for a Material 3 light theme configured according to a specific style guide. It contains private color constants and exposes a ThemeData object for consistent theming across the app.

methods.name: AppTheme.lightTheme
methods.description: A static getter that returns a ThemeData object with custom color schemes, typography, and component styles for the application's light theme.
